title: Black Hole Gravity in Newtonian Physics
content: In the centre of black holes, the energy density of dark energy diminishes accordingly to their mass. Diminished energy density of dark energy changes the electromagnetic properties, which causes that in the centre of black holes atoms become unstable. In black holes, matter decays back into elementary particles, and they decay back into dark energy. There is no gravitational singularity in the centre of a black hole. Gravity in black holes follows Newton’s Shell Theorem. Black holes lower universal entropy; they transform old matter into fresh energy composed of elementary particles that form astrophysical jets. Black holes are rejuvenating systems of the universe.
